summary.value: Also known as Nihilist, Vandal, Witch.

system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points
  • Ritualism rituals

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise.)

MALEFACTOR SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000156]{Exploit} 【Max SL 5】

Action + 10 MP: choose dazed, shaken, slow or weak. At the start of each of your later turns this conflict, every enemy suffering it takes (SL × 3) damage — no Check, no roll; the type matches an equipped weapon, else physical. One status at a time; an action switches it.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000157]{Maniacal Insight}

When a Villain enters a scene you are in, spend a Fabula Point to learn that Villain's goal for the scene.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000158]{Malefactor Magic} 【Max SL 9】

Each level teaches one Malefaction spell. Offensive Malefaction spells use (INS + WLP).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000159]{Sacrificial Gambit}

Casting an offensive single-target spell, before rolling: declare the Check an automatic success — at the cost of suffering the spell's effects yourself, High Roll 0 for both. If the spell could not affect you at all, it fails and neither of you is affected.
